questions.q: Whose son was the prophet Isaiah?
questions.evidence: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah

questions.q: "Though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as" what?
questions.evidence: Come now, and let us reason together,” says Yahweh: “Though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow

questions.q: Into what will the nations beat their swords?
questions.evidence: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks

questions.q: In the year which king died did Isaiah see the Lord on a throne?
questions.evidence: In the year that king Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up

questions.q: When the Lord asked, "Whom shall I send?", what did Isaiah answer?
questions.evidence: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me

questions.q: In the sign given to Ahaz, what would the son be called?
questions.evidence: Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel

questions.q: Which is one of the names given to the child in Isaiah 9?
questions.evidence: His name will be called Wonderful, Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace

questions.q: In Isaiah 11, the wolf will live with what?
questions.evidence: The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat

questions.q: Where does the voice call out to prepare the way of Yahweh?
questions.evidence: The voice of one who calls out, “Prepare the way of Yahweh in the wilderness

questions.q: Those who wait for Yahweh will mount up with wings like what?
questions.evidence: They will mount up with wings like eagles

questions.q: Which king does Yahweh call "my shepherd" in Isaiah 44?
questions.evidence: Who says of Cyrus, ‘He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure,’ even saying of Jerusalem, ‘She will be built

questions.q: He was led like a lamb to what?
questions.evidence: As a lamb that is led to the slaughter, and as a sheep that before its shearers is silent, so he didn’t open his mouth

questions.q: Yahweh has anointed me to preach good news to whom, in Isaiah 61?
questions.evidence: because Yahweh has anointed me to preach good news to the humble

questions.q: If heaven is Yahweh's throne, what is the earth?
questions.evidence: Yahweh says, “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool
